ClientResponses.Response: We are very sorry to hear that you are disappointed with your new grill! We have designed the Spirit II grills with two larger wheels compared to four casters so it will travel better. We recommend to move your grill using the left side table. Please push the side table first then lift your grill to move your Spirit II grill. As for your igniter issue, please try changing the battery in the igniter module. If you are still having issues, please reach out to our support team and we will be happy to assist you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill less than 6 months ago, replacing a Weber Spirit that I had had for over 15 years.  It grills fine, but the automatic igniter no longer works, and with only 2 wheels, as compared to the 4 that my previous Spirit had, it makes it more difficult to more around on our deck.
Results.Title: Disappointed in Weber Spirit II E-210

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I'm super happy with this grill and the customer service provided by this company. I ordered the grill online and it arrived with a dented hood and the porcelain in the ignition switch was broken. 
I contacted Weber about this and provided the photos that their form asked for. Literally within 15 minutes of hitting submit I received an email back stating that they had already sent an order through for the replacement items. They were sent out the next business day and arrived quickly.
Cooking on the grill has been great and it has worked perfectly each time. It is a very nice heavy weight of metal and so should last quite a bit longer than my old grill that I had had for 15 years did.
Results.Title: Great grill and Customer Serive

Results.ReviewText: This grill performs very well for us. Though much of the sheet metal is thin, I am impressed with the design and how the whole system sort of locks together when complete. The fasteners seem to be of high quality.   I would prefer a warming rack that hangs and swings from the lid rather than the grill body, because it's difficult to get to the rear of the grates with the rack in place. This grill also couldn't be much larger and still run from two burners; I have to keep mine near the highest setting all the time to keep the grill hot.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.

44060001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill
44060001.Description: Open your door to the world of grilling with the sleek Spirit II E-210 gas grill. This two burner grill is built to fit small spaces, and packed with features such as the powerful GS4 grilling system, iGrill capability, and convenient side tables for placing serving trays. Welcome to the Weber family.
